verdict.rationale: CSC is an entity-management and registered-agent SaaS, so a full data export is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never documents a bulk export of all customer data in open formats or any offboarding path. The only related items are adjacent features: SOP documents are delivered as searchable PDFs, and the integration APIs are described for connecting ELM, payroll and other systems, not for exporting everything. Neither counts as the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
